Voting Locations - Cook County

  • Services
  • County Clerk
  • Voting Locations - Cook County
Service Information

The County Clerk oversees polling places for all suburban Cook County voters. 

The link below will take you to maps of polling places and precincts for each of suburban Cook County's thirty townships.

Voters are also notified of their polling place address in a mailing prior to the election.
